def solve_knapsack_unbounded_precond (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat) : Prop :=
  (weights.length = values.length) ∧
  (weights.length > 0) ∧
  (capacity ≤ 1000) ∧
  (∀ i, i < weights.length → weights.getD i 0 > 0) ∧
  (∀ i, i < weights.length → weights.getD i 0 ≤ 1000) ∧
  (∀ i, i < values.length → values.getD i 0 ≤ 1000)

/-! ### Auxiliary definitions for the post‑condition -/

def list_nat_to_int (l : List Nat) : List Int :=
  l.map (fun x => Int.ofNat x)

def total_weight (counts weights : List Int) : Int :=
  (counts.zip weights).foldl (fun acc p => acc + p.1 * p.2) 0

def total_value (counts values : List Int) : Int :=
  (counts.zip values).foldl (fun acc p => acc + p.1 * p.2) 0

def is_valid_strategy (counts weights : List Int) (capacity : Int) : Prop :=
  counts.length = weights.length ∧
  (∀ i, i < counts.length → counts.getD i 0 ≥ 0) ∧
  total_weight counts weights ≤ capacity

def knapsackDot : List Int → List Int → Int
  | x :: xs, y :: ys => x * y + knapsackDot xs ys
  | _, _ => 0

def allNonnegative : List Int → Prop
  | [] => True
  | x :: xs => 0 ≤ x ∧ allNonnegative xs

def allPositive : List Int → Prop
  | [] => True
  | x :: xs => 1 ≤ x ∧ allPositive xs

def knapsackAttainable
    (weights values : List Nat) (capacity result : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ counts : List Int,
    is_valid_strategy counts (list_nat_to_int weights) (Int.ofNat capacity) ∧
    total_value counts (list_nat_to_int values) = Int.ofNat result

def knapsackBound (values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat) : Nat :=

    (xs ys : List Int) (acc : Int) :

  | cons x xs ih =>

    (hcv : counts.length = values.length)
    (hcounts : allNonnegative counts)
    (hweights : allPositive weights)
    (hvalues : allNonnegative values)
    (hcapacity : 0 ≤ capacity)
    (hweight : knapsackDot counts weights ≤ capacity) :

  induction counts generalizing weights values with
  | nil =>
      cases weights with

          simp at hcw
      | nil =>
          cases values with
          | cons v values =>
              simp at hcv
          | nil =>

  | cons c counts ih =>

      | nil =>

              simp at hcv

              simp only [allPositive] at hweights

                  allNonnegative weights :=
                allNonnegative_of_allPositive weights hweights.2

                  0 ≤ knapsackDot counts weights :=
                knapsackDot_nonnegative

    (list_nat_to_int l).sum = Int.ofNat l.sum := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [list_nat_to_int]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      change Int.ofNat x + (list_nat_to_int xs).sum =
        Int.ofNat (x + xs.sum)
      rw [ih]
      simp

    (n : Nat) (l : List Int) :

  induction n generalizing l with
  | zero =>
      rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      cases l with
      | nil =>
          rfl
      | cons x xs =>
          simp only [List.replicate_succ, knapsackDot, zero_mul, zero_add]
          exact ih xs

    (weights : List Nat) (capacity : Nat) :
    is_valid_strategy
      (List.replicate weights.length 0)
      (list_nat_to_int weights)
      (Int.ofNat capacity) := by

  · simp [list_nat_to_int]
  · constructor
    · intro i hi
      simp
    · rw [total_weight_eq_knapsackDot]
      rw [knapsackDot_replicate_zero]
      exact Int.natCast_nonneg capacity

    (weights values : List Nat) :

      (List.replicate weights.length 0)
      (list_nat_to_int values) = 0 := by
  rw [total_value_eq_knapsackDot]

    total_value counts (list_nat_to_int values) ≤
      Int.ofNat (knapsackBound values capacity) := by

    ⟨hcountsWeightsLength, hcountsGetD, htotalWeight⟩

  have hweightsPositive :

  have hvaluesNonnegative :

      (list_nat_to_int values)

      hcountsNonnegative
      hweightsPositive
      hvaluesNonnegative

      hdotWeight

  · exact hvalueNonnegative
  · rw [total_value_eq_knapsackDot]
    rw [list_nat_to_int_sum] at hdotValue

    (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat)
    (h_precond : solve_knapsack_unbounded_precond weights values capacity) :

      weights values capacity
      (solve_knapsack_unbounded weights values capacity h_precond)
      h_precond := by

  unfold solve_knapsack_unbounded_postcond

    rw [← hvalueEq]
    exact Int.ofNat_le.mpr hle

        knapsackAttainable weights values capacity 0 :=
      zero_knapsack_attainable weights values capacity

        knapsackAttainable weights values capacity
          (Nat.findGreatest

            (knapsackBound values capacity)) :=
